description: A minimal Angular 18 standalone app built with the SEALED @angular-devkit/build-angular:application (esbuild) builder, then obfuscated by @afterpack/angular's afterpackAngular() postbuild helper over dist/<app>/browser -- the canonical Angular path (the modern builder exposes no plugin hook). The helper auto-locates the browser output (findAngularBrowserDir), so this fixture is what exercises that published code against real `ng build` output. Proves the Angular bundle survives obfuscation: the app bootstraps + renders and the signal-based counter interaction still works in chromium.

build.note: build.mjs runs `ng build --configuration production` then calls afterpackAngular({ cwd, seed, protectionMap: true }) -- no browserDir, so findAngularBrowserDir locates dist/angular-fixture/browser itself, and the combined Protection Map lands in the gitignored .afterpack/; honors AFTERPACK_build_autorun=false for the un-obfuscated baseline

interactions.description: Clicking the counter runs the obfuscated Angular signal update and re-renders.
